title: Incremental Archer Idle Game - Feedback wanted
author: IdleLegends
selftext:
Hi Guys, 

Just wanted to share the new game I made with Claude - basically a cookie clicker clone but with an Archer killing goblins. 

Let me know what you think and if I should create new levels/maps etc. 

[https://mythosarcade.com/api/public/game/3979d5ca-01e5-470d-bcd8-9f28eca06be3](https://mythosarcade.com/api/public/game/3979d5ca-01e5-470d-bcd8-9f28eca06be3)

comments.author: Weird_Sky_104
comments.body: Needs balancing. It’s easy. Good start, quick escalation but no danger from enemy’s. Maybe a boss? Und freeze the top. I always want to see what’s going on which I can’t if the scrolling is for the whole page. I think that are some quick wins 👍

replies.author: IdleLegends
replies.body: Yeah I wasn't sure about adding the danger of dying if its an incremental game but having bosses would be pretty fun - good idea. You mean freeze the visual i-frame?

replies.author: Weird_Sky_104
replies.body: The fighting screen should be always visible. That’s the whole point of the game \^\^ it’s a quick fix for AI

comments.author: IdleLegends
comments.body:
By the way - I've also made the website that hosts these AI browser games. So feel free to add yours as well. Lots of creators on there already and close to 50 games.   
  
[https://mythosarcade.com/](https://mythosarcade.com/)

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body:
Is it playable in browser??

I am currently building a game portal similar to miniclip. newgrounds, kongregate with games from indie devs and solo creators. Would love to have your game included. It can be a link that allows iframe embed or I can send you the upload portal for file upload.

replies.author: IdleLegends
replies.body:
Hey, yep totally playable in browser. I think thats the better method tbh. 

Whats the link to the website? I've made one as well haha

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
It is currently not live, I have accumulated over 20 indie dev creators and games now. Once I publish the website I will tag everyone.

replies.body: Those are rookie numbers, gotta get into the quintillions ;)

replies.author: IdleLegends
replies.body: Thanks! It was just prompting Claude with Opus 4.8 to create a single file HTML game.

replies.author: Ill-Past4609
replies.body: How you implement the animation ? Just giving it the sprite sheet ?

replies.author: IdleLegends
replies.body:
Oh yeah sorry. I got free sprite sheets from Itch.io. They have a bunch of free assets on there. Then just fed them into Claud and told it where to use them. It didn’t make any mistakes that I needed to fix first time around, crazy. 

I’ve got a bunch of AI games hosted here if you want to check others out: MythosArcade.com

replies.author: Ill-Past4609
replies.body: Nice!! Yeah the hardest part for me right now is trying to create clean sprite sheets to use the ones you’re using I’ve used them when watching YouTube videos for Godot Tutorials on how to create animated characters etc since they are free
